amendment_summary: Move the FT2-10 Stage-2 entry GATE from the structurally unsatisfiable pessimistic-decile (q10) upside test to a calibrated conservative lower-confidence bound on the conditional arithmetic-mean expected upside (MFE and profit area, dollars and return), computed via a session-clustered mean-residual bootstrap; keep calibrated q10 only as a RANK statistic among gate-passers. Downside protection is unchanged and remains with the exit model + D48 per-trade cap + D49 daily breaker. Scope is the entry-gate criterion and the mean-head/calibration support strictly required to compute it; RLAC targets, labels, 20/1/20/4 roles, fees, simulator, exit design, guardrails, graph topology, and downstream thresholds are unchanged.

provenance_chain.note: The edcbee06 base is the uncommitted owner-signed FT2-21 authority (see protocol101_ft2_21_owner_approval/owner_approval_receipt.json). This amendment is the single next transition edcbee06 -> 82d9573e.

roles_flip: Claude wrote the amendment proposal; Codex critically reviewed (adding a required statistical correction), implemented, and resealed; Claude independently verified; owner signed.

independent_claude_verification.method: Reproduced load-bearing hashes and re-ran governance checks against source, not trusting Codex's summary.

results.anti_regression_rule_is_substantive: Forbids 'q10' in the gate rule string, requires conditional-arithmetic-mean central statistic, session-clustered calibration with individual_outcome_quantile_forbidden=true and confidence_level=0.9, and retains calibrated q10 only in the tertiary/quaternary RANK scores. A regression back to a q10 gate or an individual-outcome conformal bound flips it to fail.
results.consistency_checker_reran_independently: 32/32 pass, outcome=pass, named guard present and passing
results.entry_gate_now_satisfiable: 552 proposals cleared the amended entry gate on the Option-D Stage-1 replay (was 0/4191 under the q10 gate)

known_open_issue_not_resolved_by_this_am.summary: The full trader still produces 0 BUY on the Option-D Stage-1 replay. This is a SEPARATE downstream issue, not a defect in this entry-gate amendment.
known_open_issue_not_resolved_by_this_am.mechanism: All 552 entry-gate passers were rejected downstream. Every frozen numeric downstream gate individually rejected all 552 (uncertainty_cluster_gap, unchanged q10 MFE error margin, q90 regret), and the action-conditioned gate was unavailable (19 realized WAIT outcomes < 50 minimum). The uncertainty-margin gate requires the predicted directional cluster-gap (<=0.08, median 0.015) to exceed the model's own 90% conformal prediction-error bar (wait_margin=0.7038); the deliberately weak/thin walking-skeleton GBT on 45 sessions cannot clear it.
known_open_issue_not_resolved_by_this_am.classification: Unlike the L1 entry-gate defect (unsatisfiable for any model on any data), this is a weak-model + thin-data limitation that shrinks with a stronger model and more development data. It is the confidence gates working as designed (correct abstention).
known_open_issue_not_resolved_by_this_am.status: Owner has submitted a separate correction to Codex on the downstream gate behavior; results pending and will be independently verified before any further action. Tracked as learnings-ledger L4 (resolved) and L9 (open).

This makes no claim of profitability, alpha, or that the full trader trades; the downstream 0-BUY behavior is a separate open item under active correction.
